# v29 report (generated by report_v29.py and report_v29_hw.py)

**Time rule** (`runtime_estimate.md`, `time_rule.md`): the timing runs estimated Parts B to G at 54.0 h against the limit of 48 h. Dropped in the pre-registered order and not run: Part G (traces that load the network); Part F2 (`EB_best16`, `EB_best256`: tuning and evaluation).

# v29 Part B: scenarios never used (generated by report_v29.py)

Runs: B1 5130 of 5,130 (seeds 181-190), B2 540 of 540 (`LB_b0` on 2x2, seeds 121-130); missing 0; dead-end events 0.
pipe_all 2; the three scenarios `tornado`, `neighbour` and `randperm` (fault-free), which no earlier round ran and which the tuning of round 24 never saw.
Loads: the nine points of DeFT-P's ladders (`load_points_v29.md`). **THR** = the largest accepted throughput over the nine loads; **LAT** and **P99** at
1.0 x Lsat of DeFT-P. Effects in per cent (THR positive = higher, LAT and P99 negative = lower) with the 95 % interval over the ten seeds. **The best of a set
of references** is taken per size, scenario and metric by the mean over the seeds. Only the primary table is adjusted (Holm); every other interval is
unadjusted and descriptive.

# v29 E3: the references with more buffers (report_v29_hw.py e3)

DeFT's four routers with 5-flit and 6-flit input buffers, and with 7-flit buffers in the interposer routers only, synthesised with the flow of round 25
(NanGate45 typical, Yosys + ABC at 1 GHz) in its three forms, in one run with DeFT at depth 4 and with the main row. RTL: `hw/rtl/router_core29.v`, the
reference core of round 18 with the depths as macros; `DeFT_d4` is the core of round 18 unchanged, `DeFT_d4c` the new core at depth 4.

Functional check of the depths (`hw/buffer_core_check.txt`): All cases pass and both controls fail: yes.

## E4.2 The bench carries that load (`hw/tb/tb_act18.v`, `tb_act25.v`)

Random 8-flit packets at these rates per port, with the measured share of heads that end at the router or take its vertical link, credits after the measured
stay; calibrated on the RTL until every rate is within 3 % of the simulator's (or the closest of ten tries). The netlist is then simulated with the same
stimulus (2,000 + 10,000 cycles; the VCD holds the 10,000) and must print the same result line as the RTL.
